capabilities: Show letter hints for links and workspace controls
Find notes through a local Markdown file picker
Enter navigation mode with Esc and switch to editing with i
disambiguation: Not a Vim editing mode; it adds Vim-style navigation and scrolling, and leaves text editing to a separate edit mode.
extras: Works offline with no telemetry, account, or payment; the README points to a Chinese usage guide and full shortcut list hosted elsewhere and advises disabling other global navigation plugins that use the same keys.
problem: Moving around notes and the workspace with the keyboard alone is limited, so scrolling and activating links or controls still needs the mouse.
summary: Vim-style keyboard navigation plugin that adds continuous scrolling and letter hints for links and workspace controls.
